findings.title: Independent final readiness is missing before the permit
findings.evidence: Only prepare/red/install-fixed/green/archive phases exist. Gate requires the final permit before executing its verification and emits ALLOW only afterward. No separate final producer/result exists for root to inspect before issuing that permit. Root confirmed this exact requested order is mandatory.
findings.requiredCorrection: Fresh successor must add a gateway-specific independent read-only final readiness producer/result, inspected after actual archive/review and before a separately issued fresh permit; gate must revalidate that exact readiness/code/release/hold/artifact binding before allowing separate exit; retain separate postclose proof. No GST/C8 producer reuse.

findings.title: A resident reparented Vitest worker can escape both terminal and boundary checks
findings.evidence: Actual extracted run_native with fake tables: sample1 sees root10; fork20 starts and reparents before sample2, which contains resident20/ppid1 while root poll returns0. Function returns TERMINAL/no sticky with only10 known. Actual extracted boundary accepts ordinary Tinypool entry/process.js argv without workspace/config marker; existing core project vocabulary also excludes it. No actual process was created.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add a bounded stable candidate/UNKNOWN boundary for this unit using concrete Node/Vitest worker roles plus ownership facts such as verified cwd/FD under the exact owned workspace and parent/native history. Do not equate lack of the two argv markers with absence. Include candidates in final/gate proof; unresolved scope/identity remains HOLD. Preserve sampled-observation limits, no new signals, no complete short-lived-capture or same-UID security claim.

findings.title: Real Helm freeze checks known bytes but omit the actual path set
findings.evidence: captureScope excludes helm-chart. Auxiliary loop reads only sealed filenames. Actual extracted guards accepts a virtual extra helm-chart/put-checks/templates/EXTRA-SYNTHETIC.yaml and returns auxiliariesExact=true while every listed original remains exact.
findings.requiredCorrection: Compare the actual finite real Helm path set to the sealed expected set before/after phases and at final/gate; reject additions/removals/nonregular or unexpected links with existing scope/mode policy. Preserve expected22, rather than rebasing it. Also ensure the copied chart has the exact22 path set before native use, not merely a final file count.

findings.title: Final close does not rebind the separate runtime reports and dedicated chart archive
findings.evidence: The gate pins phase receipt JSON and compares workspace/complete-workspace archive inventories. It never reads native.reportSha256 against runtime red/green Vitest JSON, never reassesses those current reports, and never checks final-fixed-chart-archive. These separate evidence-root artifacts are outside the two inventories being checked; their change leaves these gate conditions unaffected. This is a protected-evidence binding issue, not a hostile same-UID boundary claim.
findings.requiredCorrection: New final readiness must bind and validate both current report copies/hash/phase assessments and both complete/dedicated chart archives; bind exact code/release/hold/receipts. Fresh gate validation must reject any later change to those proof inputs. Keep native exit1 separate from intended-red qualification and do not manufacture per-render observations.

findings.title: The 50 pure controls do not exercise the new boundary and exit code
findings.evidence: All50 replay as authored, but calls test assess/transition plus four AST parses. No actual held/guards/boundary/inventory/archive/monitor/final/gate conditions are exercised. The source-parsing controls cannot establish rejection of wrong/no readiness, stale release/hold, resource unknown/sticky/live, source additions or archive drift. Independent injected actual-function controls found the gaps above.
findings.requiredCorrection: Add inspected pure injection tests of actual new boundary/final/gate functions for valid path and exact negative cases: missing/wrong/stale readiness, code/release/hold mismatch, source byte/mode/path drift, receipt/native status or sticky flags, resident/reparented/unknown owned candidates, inherited boundaries and report/archive changes. Exercise the implementation, not a duplicate predicate; no native/helper-main execution. Keep success-only closure limitation explicit.
